enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Unholy 4: This weapon is used by the wicked to smite the pure, dealing an additional 4d6 evil damage on each hit. This effect makes the weapon evil aligned. Good characters wielding this weapon will suffer one negative level.
Smashing 9: The edges of this weapon are blunted, dealing an additional 9d6 bludgeoning damage on each critical hit.
Piercing 4: The edges of this weapon have serrated edges, dealing an additional 4d6 piercing damage on each hit.
Combat Mastery +6: +6 Enhancement bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip, Improved Trip, Sunder, Improved Sunder, Stunning Blow, and Stunning Fist attempts.
